AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

animovement is part of the animovement suite — the meta-package that installs, attaches and keeps the suite in sync.

Where to look things up

  • This package’s API — https://animovement.dev/animovement/llms.txt lists every exported function, grouped, with a one-line description. Full help for one function, including its exact signature, is at https://animovement.dev/animovement/reference/<function>.md.
  • Which package owns what — https://github.com/animovement/animovement-agents maps the suite: the aniframe data model, and the verb prefixes each package owns.
  • How we work — CONTRIBUTING.md.
  • Working with AI tools — AI.md.

These are generated from the source, so unlike a model’s recollection they cannot drift from the installed package.

Before you write code here

  • Verify that a function exists, and check its signature, using the reference above. This suite is eight packages that went through a split and keeps evolving, so a plausible-sounding name may belong to a different package, may have changed signature, or may never have existed.
  • Format with air, not styler. Every pull request is checked, and formatting failures block merging.
  • Run the tests — devtools::test(). Do not rely on code looking correct.
  • Do not push to main. It is protected; open a pull request. Checks must pass before merging.
  • Write the pull request title as a Conventional Commit — fix(animovement): keep metadata through filter_kalman(). Merges squash, so the title becomes the commit on main, and a workflow checks it. Types and the breaking-change rule are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
  • Fill in the pull request template rather than replacing it with generated prose.
  • Do not submit a pull request you have not read and tested yourself. See the AI policy.

Repository layout

Standard R package. R/ holds the source, man/ is generated by roxygen2 — edit the roxygen comments, never the .Rd files. tests/testthat/ holds the tests. CI lives in .github/workflows/ as thin stubs calling shared workflows in animovement/.github; change the shared workflow, not the stub.
